role: The RuntimeException that wraps a CrashReport, thrown when a tick or update crashes so the game can show the crash screen.
scope_reason: Crash reporting is oracle harness surface: the gates never crash, and the native engine emulates the few data-shaped crashes the probes reach (for example the crafting gate's thrown(out, "ReportedException") in crafting.c) without any exception machinery.
notes: No native crash-report infrastructure exists or is planned; crashes are avoided by construction.
